title: Router decision (Stage 2): .a2dlc/run/<slice>/route.json
description: The Router is deterministic and is core, not a role. Rules, in order: the criticality declared in the intent (low without an intent); it goes up one level if a changed or deleted file matches intent.critical_paths; high or critical gives N=2; dual-spec is mandatory in greenfield with effective criticality medium or higher (in refactor and brownfield_facade Stage 1 is behavior capture and the second builder is the legacy); lite mode always gives N=1 without dual-spec; with S*, the metrics rule_count and state_mutation_depth give N=2 when they cross a threshold (without an extra dual-spec). Each rule applied stays in reasons.

track.description: N=1 standard; N=2 cross-model critical (primary and orthogonal builder).

dual_spec_required.description: Whether Stage 1 must run dual-spec (specifiers α and β + inquisitor).

reasons.description: The rules that applied, in order.

touched_critical.description: Changed or deleted files (base → working tree when routing) that match critical_paths.

rule_count.description: Pre + post + invariants + errors clauses summed over all functions of S*; null without S* (no contract.json, or lite mode).

state_mutation_depth.description: Functions of S* with an invariant or whose post names by whole word another S* function, plus 1 if intent.delivery.writes; null without S*.

lemmas_required.description: True in N=2 (critical) routes: Stage 3 asks the builder for lemmas and runs the lemmas operation (protocol section 5 Stage 2). False otherwise.

metrics_reason.description: What the metrics measured, or why they are null (e.g. "without S*").
